reuse_en: Reuse it for storage or packing.

items.fact_en: Under RA 9003, recyclables must be free from contamination, so clean and dry items are the ones that get recycled.

prep_en.detail: Keep it only if it is clean, dry and intact.

items.note_en: Greasy or food-soaked paper goes in the black bin.
items.note_fil: Ang papel na may mantika o basa ng pagkain ay sa itim na basurahan.
reuse_en: Reuse it first. If it is still clean and sturdy, keep it for another trip. Recycle it when it is no longer usable.
reuse_fil: Gamitin muna ulit. Kung malinis at matibay pa, itago para sa susunod na lakad. I-recycle kapag hindi na magagamit.
items.fact_en: Reusing extends the life of paper fibers. Clean, dry paper can then be recycled; grease-soaked paper cannot.
items.fact_fil: Napapahaba ng muling paggamit ang buhay ng hibla ng papel. Nare-recycle ang malinis at tuyong papel; hindi ang may mantika.

reduce_fil: Magdala ng sariling mug o tumbler
items.fact_en: Paper cups have a plastic lining, so they can't be recycled with paper.
items.fact_fil: May plastic lining ang papel na baso kaya hindi ito nare-recycle kasama ng papel.

items.summary_en: Used paper napkins go in the green bin. If they touched chemicals, use the black bin.
items.summary_fil: Ang gamit na napkin ay sa berdeng basurahan. Kung nadikitan ng kemikal, sa itim.

items.fact_en: Under RA 9003, recyclables must be free from contamination, so clean and dry items are the ones that get recycled.
items.fact_fil: Ayon sa RA 9003, dapat walang dumi ang recyclable, kaya ang malinis at tuyo ang nare-recycle.

items.summary_fil: Thermal na papel ang makintab na resibo. Ilagay sa itim na basurahan, hindi kasama ng papel.

prep_en.title: Sort it

prep_fil.title: Itapon

items.summary_en: Bag shredded paper so it doesn't scatter, or add it to compost.

prep_en.detail: Put it in a paper bag so the strips stay together.
